experiment: V6 Stage 0 opportunity gate: single SmolVLA continue vs refresh

protocol.rounding_rule: native SmolVLA chunk has H=10; nearest integer cursors are 3,5,8 and are recorded per root
protocol.r_new_estimand: mean over independent R-new seeds, estimating expected K=1 refresh; max is diagnostic only
protocol.same_seed_contract: R-same uses the source native event generation seed with a fresh boundary observation
protocol.fixed_downstream_contract: each root uses one downstream seed and temperature shared by C, R-same, and all R-new branches

eligibility.formal: AC_R >= 0.05; task-cluster bootstrap 95% CI lower >0; P(A_R>0)>=0.05; P(A_R<0)>=0.05
eligibility.stop: if formal AC_R <0.03, change domain or source and do not train the head
